quests.instruction: SLIDE OR TAP TO MATCH THE TARGET VOWEL SOUND
quests.hint: Say 'father' out loud, then say 'bazaar'. If the stressed vowel feels the same, you are hearing /ɑː/, not the LOT vowel in 'dog'.
quests.explanation: 'bazaar' contains the PALM vowel /ɑː/: a long, open-back vowel - the mouth drops wide open with unrounded lips. This is the same vowel sound found in 'father' and 'calm'.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /ɒ/ (LOT) is short, with the lips rounded and the jaw low. /ɑː/ (PALM) is longer, with the lips relaxed and unrounded and the jaw dropped further back.
